summary: Bush-backed kerb where a row of cars already parks, no homes nearby.
reasons: Backs onto dense bush, no dwellings close
Row of parked cars along kerb

best_section.where: Russell Terrace south kerb, in the row of parked cars below the school

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush and powerlines to the south; school grounds and bush opposite; no dwellings within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with cars parked along it; a van fits in the row.
drivers.traffic: Through road, moderate; parked cars separate the van from the lane.
drivers.convention: Many cars park here; loading zone signs apply 7-9am and 2-4pm on school days only.

flags: Loading zone signs near the ends of the stretch (school days only)
Slope up to 8% max near the east end, about 2% at the best section
Creek 11 m away but ground about 15 m elevation
sun_shade: Bush shade from the south; morning shade from trees opposite; open to the north.
cannot_judge: Exact sign positions along the kerb
